scientific_integrity: Exact analytical proof and executable finite numerical probes; no randomized test is presented as an infinite proof, and no independent review or validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns deterministic groupwise source-normalized SIRD incidence, positive initial infectious seeds in every group, a positive incoming transmission edge per group, and fixed total removal rates with fatal fractions below one. Case fatality is a parameter split, not a clinical control. Classic single-group fatality monotonicity and positive-concave uniqueness are known prior results. Earlier heterogeneous-treatment full text could contain an equivalent graph sensitivity theorem.
title: Directed-path amplification of final epidemic size by fatal removal at fixed infectious duration
